messages:
Maria: Quick ping — there are 3 docs PRs stuck in review and the docs-preview CI failed on one. Can we split reviewers? PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842, /pull/844, /pull/846
Ajay: I can take SDK snippet + link fixes (842). @Sophie take migration guide? :hand:
Sophie: yep I'll grab 846 (migration guide). I'll run the preview locally first.
Maria: thanks. 844 is small: tokenization migration note + example change. Leo want to own that? @Leo
Leo: sure, I'll do 844 tonight. Any blockers on 842 CI?
doc-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #842 — build error: Missing Sphinx extension 'redwood_theme'
Ajay: odd — looks like CI image needs the new docs deps. Try adding to docs/requirements.txt:
```
redwood-theme>=1.2.0
sphinx-copybutton
```
Sophie: run: pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs build — that fixed it for me earlier.
Maria: ok assign reviewers: Ajay -> 842, Leo -> 844, Sophie -> 846. Can we do quick merges after green CI? aim for tomorrow AM.
Leo: noted. I'll also add a small test to 844 to cover the code snippet correctness.
Ajay: pinging @eng-infra for CI image update — can we get the docs image updated to include redwood-theme? :eyes:
eng-infra: (bot) raised ticket INFRA-2182 for docs CI image. ETA 24h.
Maria: perfect. If image update delays, Ajay will merge once he verifies build locally + docs-preview comment from bot.
Sophie: will add change log entry and migration notes. small nit: update link at line 42 in docs/migration.md (broken anchor).
Maria: thanks all. I'll mark these in the docs-weekly board. :white_check_mark:
